击败商店的铃珠猎人获得。: Obtained by defeating a shop's Bell Bearing Hunter.
本局后续每次进入商店，额外出售 5 件对应物品。: On each subsequent shop visit this run, 5 additional items of the corresponding type are offered.
效果可叠加，联机全队共享；本局结束后失效。: Stacks and is shared by the entire party in co-op. Expires when the run ends.
在营地铁匠或商店强化一件武器，或在营地将一件护符升至同系列最高阶、调灵一个骨灰；: Consume one stone to upgrade a weapon at a camp smith or shop, or to upgrade a talisman to the highest tier in its series or tune Spirit Ashes at a camp.
低强化武器可追赶持有武器的最高等效等级。每到营地获得一块，在营地用它代替补充圣杯: Low-level weapons can catch up to the highest equivalent upgrade level among your weapons. Receive one stone at each camp in place of a flask refill. Stones remain after leaving camp and are cleared when a new run begins.
单人旅程中死亡时自动消耗一个：旅程不会结束，复活后自动返回死亡的房间重新挑战，生: Automatically consumes one on death during a solo run. The run continues, returning you to the room where you died to try again. HP and flasks are restored to their state upon entering that floor.
每次旅程开始时获得两个，旅程结束时收回；联机旅程不能使用。: Receive two at the start of each run. Removed when the run ends. Cannot be used in co-op runs.
购买后自动获得或升一级，最高三级，不占护符槽，不与同名护符效果重复叠加；重新开始: Purchasing grants or upgrades this blessing by one level, up to level 3. Uses no talisman slot and does not stack with the matching talisman effect. Resets when a new run begins.
降低物理伤害并增强防御反击；升级提高减伤。: Reduces physical damage taken and enhances guard counters. Upgrades improve damage negation.
增强蓄力攻击；二级增加跳跃攻击，三级增加突刺反击。: Enhances charged attacks. Level 2 also enhances jump attacks; level 3 adds thrusting counterattack damage.
加快耐力恢复；二级增加装备重量上限，三级进一步提高。: Speeds up stamina recovery. Level 2 increases maximum equip load; level 3 increases it further.
附近出血时提升攻击；二级追加连续攻击增益，三级强化连击增益。: Raises attack power when blood loss occurs nearby. Level 2 adds a successive-attack bonus; level 3 improves that bonus.
增强魔法；二级提高增益，三级缩短施法时间。: Enhances sorceries. Level 2 improves the bonus; level 3 shortens casting time.
增强火伤并增加物理承伤；另获火焰减伤，升级提高火焰减伤。: Raises fire damage dealt and physical damage taken. Also grants fire damage negation, which improves with upgrades.
提高最大生命；升级提高增益，不直接补血。: Raises maximum HP. Upgrades improve the bonus. Does not directly restore HP.
提高最大耐力；升级提高增益。: Raises maximum stamina. Upgrades improve the bonus.

同类同稀有度只能装备一枚。: Only one talisman of the same type and rarity can be equipped.
同稀有度的命中触发护符不能同时装备。: On-hit talismans of the same rarity cannot be equipped together.
同类效果不能重复装备。: Cannot equip multiple talismans with the same type of effect.
